name: Deploy Sentinel
description: Correlates production incidents with recent deploys, and lets an agent request a rollback under the team's own rules.

rollback_window_minutes.label: How recent a deploy must be to be rollback-eligible

require_incident_label.label: Only correlate issues labelled as incidents

hooks.name: Correlate recent deploys
hooks.description: Given a service and a time window, list the deploys that landed in that window with their commit, author and blast radius. Call this first when investigating a production incident: it is the fastest way to find out what changed. Returns an empty list when nothing deployed, which is itself a useful answer.

service.description: Service name, without the configured prefix.

window_minutes.description: How far back to look. Defaults to 120.

hooks.name: Request a rollback
hooks.description: Open a rollback change request for one deploy. This does NOT roll anything back by itself: it files the request and returns a change id for a human to approve. Refuses deploys older than the configured window, and requires a written reason that goes into the change record.

reason.description: Why this deploy is suspected. Goes into the change record verbatim.

hooks.name: Page the on-call engineer
hooks.description: Fires when an issue is created or changes status, so a new incident reaches a human without anybody watching the board.

hooks.name: Metrics queries
hooks.description: Tools from the team's own metrics MCP server: time series, alert history, and service dependency lookups.
